metadata.question: Did nighttime lights in Obolon, Ukraine, decrease in May 2022 compared to March 2022?

data.raw_code: The question asks about nighttime lights in Obolon, Ukraine comparing May 2022 vs March 2022. I need to: 1. Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VNP46A2 collection) which provides daily nighttime light data 2. Define Obolon, Ukraine geometry (a district in Kyiv) 3. Filter for March 2022 and May 2022 periods 4. Mask clouds/quality issues using the mandatory quality flags 5. Calculate mean radiance values for each period 6. Compare the values to determine if there was a decrease For nighttime lights, I should use the VIIRS VNP46A2 collection which has: - 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL' band for radiance values - 'QF_Cloud_Mask' band for quality filtering I need to check collection sizes, valid pixel counts, and ensure the calculations are valid. Obolon is a district in Kyiv, Ukraine. I'll use a polygon around its approximate coordinates. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const obolon = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [30.470, 50.520], [30.530, 50.520], [30.530, 50.490], [30.470, 50.490], [30.470, 50.520] ]]); const march2022 = ee.DateRange('2022-03-01', '2022-03-31'); const may2022 = ee.DateRange('2022-05-01', '2022-05-31'); // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Nighttime Lights const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VNP46A2') .select(['DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL', 'QF_Cloud_Mask']); const marchCol = viirs.filterDate(march2022).filterBounds(obolon); const mayCol = viirs.filterDate(may2022).filterBounds(obolon); // Check collection sizes const marchSize = marchCol.size().getInfo(); const maySize = mayCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`March 2022 Images: ${marchSize}`); console.log(`May 2022 Images: ${maySize}`); if (marchSize === 0 || maySize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create monthly composites and mask poor quality function maskPoorQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('QF_Cloud_Mask'); // Keep only highest quality pixels (clear, no clouds) const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); // Bits 0-1 = 00 (clear) return image.select('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL').updateMask(mask); } const marchComposite = marchCol.map(maskPoorQuality).median(); const mayComposite = mayCol.map(maskPoorQuality).median(); // 4. Calculate mean radiance values const marchStats = marchComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mayStats = mayComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const marchRad = marchStats.get('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL').getInfo(); const mayRad = mayStats.get('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixel counts const marchCount = marchComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL').getInfo(); const mayCount = mayComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL').getInfo(); console.log(`March radiance: ${marchRad ? marchRad.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${marchCount}`); console.log(`May radiance: ${mayRad ? mayRad.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${mayCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (marchCount === 0 || mayCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (marchRad === null || mayRad === null || isNaN(marchRad) || isNaN(mayRad) || marchRad < 0 || mayRad < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (mayRad < marchRad) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
